title: От Матфея 5 — Matthew 5
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: ___, стоящий на вершине холма, невозможно скрыть.
cases.translation: A city set on a hill cannot be hidden.
cases.explain: Город is the subject (a city) → nominative.

cases.translation: You are the salt of the earth.
cases.explain: соль чего — genitive shows possession: соль земли (salt of the earth).

cases.sentence: Ты не выйдешь оттуда, пока не выплатишь все до последнего ___.
cases.translation: You will not get out until you have paid the last penny.
cases.explain: до + genitive: до гроша (down to the last penny).

cases.sentence: Пусть также свет ваш светит ___, чтобы они видели ваши добрые дела.
cases.translation: In the same way, let your light shine before people, that they may see your good deeds.
cases.explain: светить кому — 'to shine for someone' takes the dative: людям.

cases.sentence: Если ты приносишь в дар ___ свою жертву, и перед жертвенником вспомнишь, что твой брат обижен на тебя.
cases.translation: If you are offering your gift to God, and there remember that your brother has something against you.
cases.explain: приносить в дар кому — dative marks the recipient: Богу.

cases.sentence: Кто назовет своего ___ ничтожеством, тот будет отвечать перед высшим советом.
cases.translation: Whoever calls his brother worthless will answer to the high council.
cases.explain: назвать (кого) — transitive verb governs the accusative; for animate masculine nouns accusative = genitive: брата.

cases.sentence: Кто ударит тебя в правую ___, то поверни к нему и другую.
cases.translation: If anyone strikes you on the right cheek, turn to him the other also.
cases.explain: в + accusative (the target of a blow): в щёку (on the cheek).

cases.sentence: Блаженны чистые ___, потому что они увидят Бога.
cases.translation: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
cases.explain: чистый чем — instrumental of respect: чист сердцем (pure in heart).

cases.sentence: Тот, кто лишь смотрит на женщину с ___, уже нарушил супружескую верность в своем сердце.
cases.translation: Whoever looks at a woman with lust has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

cases.sentence: Исполнится воля Твоя, на земле, как и на ___.
cases.translation: Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
cases.explain: на + prepositional (plural) for location: на небесах (in heaven).

reading.ru: Блаженны нищие духом, потому что им принадлежит небесное царство.
reading.question: Who does Jesus say the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to, in the first beatitude?
reading.explain: Jesus says the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to the poor in spirit.

reading.ru: Блаженны кроткие, потому что они наследуют землю.
reading.question: What will the meek inherit, according to Jesus?
reading.explain: Jesus says the meek will inherit the earth.

reading.ru: Ликуйте и веселитесь, потому что вас ждет великая награда на небесах.
reading.question: What does Jesus tell the persecuted to do, and why?
options: Rejoice, because their reward in heaven is great
reading.correct: Rejoice, because their reward in heaven is great
reading.explain: Jesus tells the persecuted to rejoice because their reward in heaven is great.

reading.question: What does Jesus call his followers, using an image of seasoning?
reading.explain: Jesus calls his followers the salt of the earth.

reading.ru: Зажженный светильник не ставят под сосуд, наоборот, его ставят на подставку, чтобы светил всем в доме.
reading.question: Where should a lit lamp be placed, according to Jesus?
options: On a stand, so it gives light to everyone in the house
Under a basket, so it doesn't burn anyone
Outside the house, away from danger
reading.correct: On a stand, so it gives light to everyone in the house
reading.explain: A lamp is put on a stand so it gives light to everyone in the house.

reading.ru: Я пришел, чтобы исполнить, а не отменить.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about his relationship to the Law and the Prophets?
options: He came to fulfill them, not abolish them
He came to replace them entirely
reading.correct: He came to fulfill them, not abolish them
reading.explain: Jesus says he came to fulfill the Law and the Prophets, not abolish them.

reading.ru: Я же говорю вам, что если человек затаил злобу на брата, он будет судим.
reading.question: According to Jesus, who is in danger of judgment, beyond just murderers?
options: Anyone who harbors anger against his brother
Only those who curse in public
reading.correct: Anyone who harbors anger against his brother
reading.explain: Jesus extends judgment to anyone who harbors anger against a brother.

reading.ru: Я же говорю вам, что тот, кто лишь смотрит на женщину с вожделением, уже нарушил супружескую верность в своем сердце.
reading.question: According to Jesus, when has a man already committed adultery in his heart?
options: When he looks at a woman with lust
Only when he physically commits adultery
reading.correct: When he looks at a woman with lust
reading.explain: Jesus says looking at a woman with lust is already adultery in the heart.

reading.ru: Я же говорю вам, что каждый, кто разводится со своей женой не по причине ее измены, толкает ее к нарушению супружеской верности.
reading.question: What does Jesus say about divorcing a wife for reasons other than unfaithfulness?
options: It is praised by the Pharisees
reading.explain: Jesus says divorcing a wife without cause of unfaithfulness pushes her toward adultery.

reading.ru: Я же говорю вам, не клянитесь вовсе».
reading.question: What does Jesus teach about making oaths?
options: Do not swear oaths at all
reading.correct: Do not swear oaths at all
reading.explain: Jesus teaches his followers not to swear oaths at all.

reading.ru: Я же говорю вам, любите ваших врагов и молитесь о тех, кто преследует вас, чтобы вам быть истинными сынами вашего Небесного Отца.
reading.question: What does Jesus command regarding enemies, at the end of the chapter?
options: Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you
Report your enemies to the authorities
Ask God to punish your enemies
reading.correct: Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you
reading.explain: Jesus commands his followers to love their enemies and pray for their persecutors.
